name: Full Load Rejection
description: The generator breaker opens on a grid disturbance while the turbine is still admitting steam. Shaft speed rises toward the overspeed trip; the turbine trips and the reactor follows.
briefing: The grid rejects the unit's load at t+25 s. Watch turbine speed and the overspeed protection, then manage the trip.
learning_objectives: Why a sudden loss of electrical load causes turbine overspeed
Overspeed protection and its relationship to the governor valves
Difference between load rejection and a simple turbine trip
